Each file owns its own rules. Key handling (RS256, kid thumbprint, private-field stripping) lives only in jwks.service.ts. Verification policy (VERIFY_OPTIONS issuer/clockTolerance, token-type checks, payload narrowing) lives only in jwt-verifier.service.ts. Neither file repeats a rule from the other.
